datasets.name: DROID
datasets.license: Check upstream dataset terms before redistribution
datasets.embodiment: Franka-style mobile/tabletop manipulation data collected across many real robot setups

datasets.name: Open X-Embodiment / RT-X
datasets.license: Mixed source licenses; validate per included dataset
datasets.download: Use the official TensorFlow Datasets or converted mirrors.
datasets.recommended_role: Broad co-training source for embodiment-aware pi0.5/pi0.7-ready experiments.

datasets.name: BridgeData V2
datasets.license: Check upstream dataset terms before redistribution
datasets.download: Use the upstream BridgeData V2 release or converted LeRobot-style mirrors.
datasets.recommended_role: Language-conditioned tabletop manipulation source for BC/SFT.

datasets.name: LIBERO
datasets.license: Check upstream benchmark terms before redistribution
datasets.download: Local default: E:\projects\robot\data\lerobot_libero; HF dataset: lerobot/libero.
datasets.recommended_role: Primary v1 training and MuJoCo/LIBERO evaluation loop.

datasets.name: Ego4D
datasets.license: Check Ego4D license and access terms
datasets.download: Use Ego4D official download tools after account/license approval.
datasets.recommended_role: Semantic hand-object interaction, affordance, subgoal, and failure annotation source.

datasets.name: EgoDex
datasets.license: Check upstream dataset terms before redistribution
datasets.download: Use the upstream EgoDex release instructions.
datasets.recommended_role: Dexterous hand-object affordance and subgoal supervision; not low-level robot action training.

datasets.name: Universal Manipulation Interface
datasets.license: Check upstream UMI terms before redistribution
datasets.embodiment: Handheld gripper demonstrations mapped to robot manipulation
datasets.download: Use upstream UMI data and calibration tooling.
datasets.recommended_role: Human-in-the-wild demonstration source for gripper-centric grasping policies.

datasets.license: Check upstream benchmark terms before redistribution

datasets.download: Use the upstream RoboCasa installation and asset instructions.

datasets.name: RoboTwin 2.0
datasets.license: Check upstream benchmark terms before redistribution
datasets.download: Use the upstream RoboTwin release instructions.
